item.title: NTA AISSEE Sainik School Admission 2027 Online Form
NTA JEE Main Session 1 Online Form 2027
item.description: NTA JEE Main 2027 Session 1 is conducted by the National Testing Agency (NTA) for admission to B.E./B.Tech, B.Arch and B.Planning courses. Eligible candidates who passed Class 12th in 2025 or 2026, or are appearing in 2027, can apply. There is no age limit for appearing in the examination. The online application process starts on 24 October 2026 and closes on 22 November 2026. The examination will be held on 20, 21, 22, 23, 24 and 28 January 2027. Candidates should check the eligibility criteria, application fee, exam pattern and important instructions before submitting the online form.
